captions.caption: A black screen quickly transitions into a view of an ash-covered street from inside a vehicle.
People walk through a street blanketed in thick grey volcanic ash under a dark, hazy sky.
A man in a blue shirt runs across the ash-laden road carrying bags while others walk in the background.
Several individuals wearing masks and carrying belongings walk quickly along a sidewalk covered in deep grey dust.
Pedestrians navigate the ash-filled street as a person in a white dress walks away from the camera's view.
The camera pans slightly to show more of the urban environment where volcanic ash has settled on every surface.
Residents continue to move through the hazy, grey environment as the sky remains heavily overcast with ash.
A wide shot from the vehicle captures the extensive layer of ash covering the road and nearby buildings.
The vehicle moves slowly forward, revealing a street where visibility is significantly reduced by airborne volcanic debris.
A man walks past the car window as the monochrome, ash-covered landscape of the town is displayed.
People in masks and carrying bags hurry down the grey street through the thick accumulation of volcanic ash.
The camera captures the bleak appearance of the town under the weight of the ongoing volcanic ash fall.
A group of people gathers near a red building on the right side of the ash-covered street.
The view from the dashboard shows the windshield wipers have cleared a small area, revealing the grey road ahead.
More people are seen in the distance, walking through the hazy and ash-filled atmosphere of the town.
The grey ash covers the entire road surface, making the street resemble a snowy landscape under a dark sky.
A close-up view through the car window reveals the fine, powdery texture of the ash settled on the ground.
The video captures the somber mood of the town as residents navigate the aftermath of the volcanic eruption.
The scene ends with a final view of the ash-covered street before the video cuts to a black screen.
A brief black screen transitions between the street scene and the subsequent footage taken on the water.
A view from a small boat shows people wearing masks on dark, choppy water under a stormy, grey sky.
The boat bounces on the waves while another boat filled with people is seen navigating nearby.
Passengers in the boat look out at the dark, ash-filled clouds looming over the distant hills and coastline.
The camera pans across the water, showing the rough sea and the overcast, ominous sky filled with volcanic clouds.
The boat continues to move through the waves as the passengers hold on while looking back at the land.
Another boat is seen in the distance, carrying more people through the dark and turbulent waters.
The sound of the boat engine is prominent as it cuts through the waves under the heavy grey sky.
A person in a yellow shirt is visible in the foreground as the boat tilts with the motion of the sea.
The camera captures the view of the receding coastline, which is shrouded in thick, dark volcanic clouds.
Passengers in the boat look towards the horizon where the grey sky and sea meet in a dense haze.
The boat rides over a large wave, splashing water as it moves away from the ash-covered island.
The camera turns to show the wake of the boat and the dark, turbulent sea behind the vessel.
A massive, dark ash cloud is visible in the sky, dominating the landscape behind the evacuating boats.
The boat continues its journey through the choppy water under the threatening, ash-filled volcanic sky.
A close-up of the water surface shows the dark color and the intensity of the waves surrounding the boat.
The camera points upwards towards the dense, swirling clouds of volcanic ash and steam in the sky.
The boat passengers remain seated and calm, some looking back at the erupting volcano's massive plume.
The view shifts to the side of the boat, showing the rough water and the distant, haze-covered coastline.
A person's face is briefly seen as they look out at the dramatic and frightening volcanic activity.
The camera pans back to the other boat, which is also full of residents evacuating the affected area.
The boat encounters more waves, causing it to rock significantly as it moves further into the open sea.
The dark clouds seem to descend lower over the water, reducing visibility even further for the boat's occupants.
The scene on the boat ends, followed by a transition to a black screen before the next segment.
A brief black screen appears before the video shows the ash-covered deck of a large ship or ferry.
The camera pans across the deck of a large vessel, which is completely blanketed in thick grey volcanic ash.
Ash is visible on the benches, floors, and railings of the ship's outdoor passenger seating area.
The camera moves quickly, showing the white railings contrasting with the heavy coating of dark grey ash.
The view looks out from the ship at the grey, hazy sea where visibility is extremely poor due to falling ash.
Thick ash covers the deck, with some areas showing footprints and trails from movement on the ship.
The camera pans back towards the covered part of the deck, showing the extensive accumulation of ash.
A close-up shot shows the significant depth of the ash on the deck's surface as the camera moves past.
The white benches on the deck are covered in a uniform layer of fine, grey volcanic dust and debris.
The camera captures the surreal sight of the ship's deck appearing as if covered in dark grey snow.
More of the ship's deck and various pieces of equipment are shown, all coated in the same thick ash layer.
The camera looks down at a pile of ash that has collected against the base of a structure on the deck.
The camera pans up to show the ceiling of the deck area, where ash has also settled on some surfaces.
The view shifts to another part of the deck, showing the total coverage of the volcanic fall on the vessel.
The camera moves towards a window, showing the ash-filled air and low visibility outside the ship.
The final seconds show the desolate, ash-covered environment on the ship as it sails through the volcanic haze.
The video concludes with a final shot of the ship's deck completely covered in a thick layer of grey ash.
